Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing a new subaccount in the public works assistance account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public water projects; and adding a new sectionto chapter 43.155 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.155 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The board must create a subaccount in the public worksassistance account. The subaccount is established to receive money tofund the following projects: (a) Water storage projects; and (b) watersystems facilities. (2) The projects listed in subsection (1) of this section mustcomply with the competitive bid requirements of RCW 43.155.060.
